The chart displays four stacked bars, one for each post-training stage, not five individual bars.

The vertical axis has tick labels at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100, indicating tick intervals of 20%, not 10%.
This inaccurately describes the vertical axis, which has a scale from 0% to 100%. The value 90.0% is the largest data point for a single segment, not the top of the axis range.
